mechanism_claims.claim_text: Electron microscopy supports direct bacterial-envelope damage for the active peptidomimetics, with Pep18 retained as the less-active natural-amino-acid comparator rather than overclaimed as the active lead.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane-permeability assays support outer/inner membrane permeation in Escherichia coli and Sytox Green permeability in MSSA/MRSA, with activity strongest for Pep16/Pep19 and weaker/inactive comparator behavior for Pep18.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Final interpretation is membrane permeabilization/damage, not a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR/SUV and molecular modeling evidence supports stronger association of Pep19 with bacterial-mimic anionic lipid environments than Pep18 and links active analog structure to bactericidal behavior.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural context supports the mechanism model and relative activity; it does not replace direct antimicrobial activity rows.
